info.title: AegisOne
info.description:
AegisOne — Secure Remote Device Management for device owners and authorized operators.

**Developed by Devang Shah.**

get.description:
Real implementation arrives when Postgres and Redis clients are wired.

For Milestone 1 we return 200 with explicit dependencies so the
compose stack can prove connectivity at the TCP layer via Docker
healthchecks. Once the auth slice lands this returns 503 if any
dependency is unreachable.

CommandIn.title: CommandIn
CommandIn.description:
POST /devices/{id}/command/{capability} body.

Every sensitive command carries a ``session_seconds`` hint so the
agent can scope the consent and the screen-share window. The dashboard
does NOT pre-grant consent — the agent will prompt the device owner.

DeviceActivityEventIn.title: DeviceActivityEventIn
DeviceActivityEventIn.description: A single event in the batch posted to /devices/{id}/activity.

DeviceConsentIn.title: DeviceConsentIn
DeviceConsentIn.description: POST /devices/{id}/consents body — pushed from the device's UI.

DeviceConsentOut.title: DeviceConsentOut
DeviceConsentOut.description: A single active consent for the device.

DeviceDetailOut.title: DeviceDetailOut
DeviceDetailOut.description: Device detail plus active consents + last activity.

DeviceOut.title: DeviceOut
DeviceOut.description: Public device view returned by list / detail endpoints.

EnrollConfirmIn.title: EnrollConfirmIn
EnrollConfirmIn.description:
POST /devices/enroll/confirm body (agent side).

The agent exchanges a valid ``pairing_code`` for a credential pair.
``device_id`` is the pre-allocated UUID returned by ``/enroll/request``.

EnrollRequestOut.title: EnrollRequestOut
EnrollRequestOut.description:
POST /devices/enroll/request response.

``pairing_code`` is the 6-digit code the operator types or scans on
the device. ``expires_at`` is the absolute ISO timestamp after which
the code no longer pairs (default 10 minutes).

InstalledAppIn.title: InstalledAppIn
InstalledAppIn.description: A single row in the /devices/{id}/apps snapshot.

TokenPair.title: TokenPair
TokenPair.description: Access + refresh token pair returned by login and refresh.

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description: Public user profile — never includes ``password_hash`` or lockout state.
